newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end sharply higher as Tokyo stocks tumble.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end sharply higher as Tokyo stocks tumble.

text.p: Key March Japanese government bond futures rose sharply toward the close on Friday, as Tokyo share prices nosedived in the afternoon.
Traders said the sharp fall in share prices led to the view that current low interest rates would remain unchanged for the time being, and was supportive of JGBs.
Arbitrage trades involving selling of stock futures and buying of JGB futures propelled JGBs higher, a brokerage house trader said.
The March ended at 125.37, up from previous day's 124.95.
Demand for cash bonds may also have been responsible for the sharp climb in JGBs, a trader for a city bank's securities affiliate said.
"Buying of government-guaranteed and municipal bonds by city banks triggered the rise in JGBs," the trader said.

Some said a U.S. news agency article which quoted some money traders as saying the Bank of Japan may be pressured by the Ministry of Finance to loosen its credit policy to support Tokyo share prices, also helped lift the JGB market.
There were mixed views in the market about the overall effect of the weakness of Tokyo share prices.
